hni_signals: VERY SENIOR ACADEMIC-CLINICAL FIGURE, 34+ years. FISN - Fellow of the Indian Society of Nephrology, and independently confirmed as a listed FISN awardee on the ISN's own national society website (isn-india.org/fisn-awardees) - a national-body honour, not a self-declared title. PUBLISHED VOLUMES STATED VERBATIM by the source: '75 research papers in peer-reviewed journals' and '125 platform presentations in National and International conferences and webinars'. Author of multiple book chapters. EXAMINER: National Board of Examinations, Delhi, examiner for the nephrology super-specialty for several years, and a DNB training teacher for the last three decades - a teaching-hospital gatekeeper role. Invited faculty at many national conferences. Principal investigator / participant in various clinical drug trials in nephrology (pharma trial income stream). Deep qualification stack: MBBS Medical College Calcutta (1983), DTCD Vallabhbhai Patel Chest Institute Delhi (1987), MD General Medicine Patna Medical College (1989), DM Nephrology Sanjay Gandhi PGIMS Lucknow (1993), DNB Nephrology (NBE), FISN. Sub-specialty interests in diabetic kidney disease, heart failure in CKD, lupus nephritis, transplant infection and acid-base/electrolyte disorders. Career across major Hyderabad private hospitals - CARE Banjara Hills now, previously Virinchi Hospitals and Medwin Hospitals, with a directory listing also citing Premier Hospital, Toli Chowki. Active medical-media presence: named author at Medical Dialogues / Health Dialogues, HCP profile on Medtalks, and a Doctube video channel.
